When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:


```{r}

library(readxl)
prevalence_od <- read_excel("prevalence_od.xlsx")
View(prevalence_od)

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)


library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)

# Ensure Age Group is ordered correctly (if it's not already)
prevalence_od$`Age Group` <- factor(prevalence_od$`Age Group`, 
                                    levels = unique(prevalence_od$`Age Group`))


custom_colors <- c("Carious Disease" = "#1f77b4",   # standard blue
                   "Periodontitis"   = "#08306b",   # dark blue
                   "Edentulism"      = "#7a0177")   # violet
ggplot(prevalence_od, aes(x = `Age Group`, y = Prevalence, 
                          group = interaction(Gender, `Oral Disease`),
                          linetype = Gender, color = `Oral Disease`)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Male" = "solid", "Female" = "dotted")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors,
                     labels = c("Carious Disease" = "Carious Disease (number of teeth)",
                                "Periodontitis" = "Periodontitis",
                                "Edentulism" = "Edentulism")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M")) +
  labs(title = "Prevalence of Oral Diseases by Age and Gender",
       x = "Age Group",
       y = "Prevalence (number of cases in Millions)",
       color = "Oral Disease",
       linetype = "Gender") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "right") # Legend to the right

ggsave("prevalence_plot1.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)


ggplot(prevalence_od, aes(x = `Age Group`, y = Prevalence,
                          group = Gender, linetype = Gender, color = Gender)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M")) +
  facet_wrap(~ `Oral Disease`, scales = "free_y") +  # Free Y scale per disease
  labs(title = "Prevalence of Oral Diseases by Age and Gender",
       x = "Age Group",
       y = "Prevalence (number of cases in Millions)",
       color = "Gender",
       linetype = "Gender") +
  theme_minimal() +
   theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "right")

custom_age_order <- c("12", "35-39", "40-44", "65-69", "70-74", "75-79", "80-84", "85+")
x_axis_labels <- c("12 years","35-39 years", "40-44 years","65-69 years", "70-74 years", "75-79 years", "80-84 years", "85+ years")
names(x_axis_labels) <- custom_age_order


prev_1 <- ggplot(prevalence_od, aes(x = `Age Group`, y = Prevalence,
                          group = Gender, linetype = Gender, color = Gender)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Male" = "#1f77b4", "Female" = "#08306b")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_axis_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M")) +
  facet_wrap(~ `Oral Disease`, scales = "free_y") +  # Free Y scale per disease
  labs(title = "Prevalence of Oral Diseases by Age and Gender",
       x = "Age Group",
       y = "Prevalence (number of cases in Millions)",
       color = "Gender",
       linetype = "Gender") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "right")



ggsave("prev_1.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}

# Get all unique Oral Diseases and Genders
oral_diseases <- unique(prevalence_od$`Oral Disease`)
genders <- unique(prevalence_od$Gender)

# Create break rows for all combinations
break_rows <- expand.grid(
  `Age Group` = c("//1", "//2"),
  Gender = genders,
  `Oral Disease` = oral_diseases,
  Prevalence = NA_real_,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Add the breaks into your dataset
prevalence_od2 <- bind_rows(prevalence_od, break_rows) %>%
  mutate(`Age Group` = factor(`Age Group`, levels = custom_age_order))


ggplot() +
  # continuous lines on real data (excluding breaks)
  geom_line(data = prevalence_od %>% filter(!`Age Group` %in% c("//1", "//2")),
            aes(x = `Age Group`, y = Prevalence,
                group = interaction(Gender, `Oral Disease`),
                color = Gender, linetype = Gender),
            size = 1.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
  # points including break points for axis break effect
  geom_point(data = prevalence_od2,  # data with breaks
             aes(x = `Age Group`, y = Prevalence,
                 color = Gender, shape = Gender),
             size = 2, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M")) +
  facet_wrap(~ `Oral Disease`, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_axis_labels) +
  labs(title = "Prevalence of Oral Diseases by Age and Gender",
       x = "Age Group",
       y = "Prevalence (number of cases in Millions)",
       color = "Gender",
       linetype = "Gender") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "right")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
socialstatus <- read_excel("socialstatus.xlsx")
View(socialstatus)

socialstatus_long <- socialstatus %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = `low-income`:`high-income`,
               names_to = "income_group",
               values_to = "prevalence")

# Apply label formatting
socialstatus_long <- socialstatus_long %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c("Male", "Female")),  # ensures left: male, right: female
    income_group = factor(income_group, 
                          levels = c("low-income", "middle-income", "high-income")),
    disease = recode(disease,
                     "carious" = "Carious Disease",
                     "periodontitis" = "Periodontitis",
                     "edentulism" = "Edentulism"),
    disease = factor(disease, 
                     levels = c("Carious Disease", "Periodontitis", "Edentulism"))
  )

# Custom purple shades
purple_shades <- c("low-income" = "#d0a9f5", 
                   "middle-income" = "#a86cf0", 
                   "high-income" = "#6a0dad")

# Create grouped bar chart
prevalence_ses <- ggplot(socialstatus_long, aes(x = disease, y = prevalence * 100, fill = income_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  facet_wrap(~ gender) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Socio-Economic Status",
    values = purple_shades,
    labels = c("Low-Income", "Middle-Income", "High-Income")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Prevalence of Oral Diseases by Gender and Socio-Economic Status",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Prevalence (in %)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "right"  # <- this places it to the right
  )

ggsave("prevalence_ses.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
yld_od <- read_excel("yld_od.xlsx")
View(yld_od)
df <- read_excel("yld_od.xlsx")
colnames(df) <- c("Age_Group", "Gender", "Oral_Disease", "YLD_per_100k")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    YLD_per_100k = as.numeric(YLD_per_100k),
    Age_Group = factor(Age_Group, levels = c("12", "35-39", "40-44", "45-49", "50-54", "55-59",
                                              "60-64", "65-69", "70-74", "75-79", "80-84", "85+")),
    Gender = as.factor(Gender),
    Oral_Disease = as.factor(Oral_Disease)
  )

# Fill in missing combinations
df_complete <- df %>%
  complete(Age_Group, Gender, Oral_Disease, fill = list(YLD_per_100k = 0))

# ✅ Final working stacked area chart

ggplot(df_complete, aes(x = Age_Group, y = YLD_per_100k, fill = Oral_Disease, group = Oral_Disease)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack") +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender, ncol = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Total YLDs per 100,000 of Oral Diseases by Age and Gender",
       x = "Age Group", y = "YLDs per 100,000") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))



```

```{r}
 library(dplyr)

# Use unique internal codes, but show both as "//" in the final plot
custom_age_order <- c("12", "//1", "35-39", "40-44", "//2", "65-69", "70-74", "75-79", "80-84", "85+")
x_axis_labels <- c("12 years", "//", "35–39 years", "40–44 years", "//",

  mutate(Age_Group = case_when(
    Age_Group == "12" ~ "12",
    Age_Group == "35-39" ~ "35-39",
    Age_Group == "40-44" ~ "40-44",
    Age_Group == "65-69" ~ "65-69",
    Age_Group == "70-74" ~ "70-74",
    Age_Group == "75-79" ~ "75-79",
    Age_Group == "80-84" ~ "80-84",
    Age_Group == "85+" ~ "85+",
    TRUE ~ Age_Group
  )) %>%
  # Insert dummy rows with unique break labels
  bind_rows(
    data.frame(Age_Group = c("//1", "//2"), YLD_per_100k = NA, Oral_Disease = NA, Gender = "Male")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Age_Group = factor(Age_Group, levels = custom_age_order))

# Plot with visual breaks

       y = "YLDs per 100,000",

scale_fill_brewer(
  palette = "Set2",
  labels = c("Mild Carious Disease", "Severe Carious Disease", "Periodontitis", "Edentulism"),
  na.translate = FALSE  # <-- this hides the grey NA swatch in the legend
) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_axis_labels) +  # Show both breaks as "//"
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Save the updated chart
ggsave("total_yld_male_break1.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Define custom age order with unique internal codes for breaks
custom_age_order <- c("12", "//1", "35-39", "40-44", "//2", "65-69", "70-74", "75-79", "80-84", "85+")
x_axis_labels <- c("12 years", "//", "35-39 years", "40-44 years", "//", "65-69 years", "70-74 years", "75-79 years", "80-84 years", "85+ years")

# Prepare Female data
df_female <- df_complete %>%
  filter(Gender == "Female" & !(Age_Group %in% c("45-49", "50-54", "55-59", "60-64"))) %>%
  mutate(Age_Group = case_when(
    Age_Group == "14" ~ "14",
    Age_Group == "35-39" ~ "35-39",
    Age_Group == "40-44" ~ "40-44",
    Age_Group == "65-69" ~ "65-69",
    Age_Group == "70-74" ~ "70-74",
    Age_Group == "75-79" ~ "75-79",
    Age_Group == "80-84" ~ "80-84",
    Age_Group == "85+" ~ "85+",
    TRUE ~ Age_Group
  )) %>%
  # Insert dummy rows to create axis breaks
  bind_rows(
    data.frame(Age_Group = c("//1", "//2"), YLD_per_100k = NA, Oral_Disease = NA, Gender = "Female")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Age_Group = factor(Age_Group, levels = custom_age_order))

# Plot for Female
total_yld_female_break1 <- ggplot(df_female, aes(x = Age_Group, y = YLD_per_100k, fill = Oral_Disease, group = Oral_Disease)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack", na.rm = TRUE) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Total YLDs of Oral Diseases per 100,000 by Age for Females",
       x = "Age Group", 
       y = "YLDs per 100,000", 
       fill = "Oral Disease") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2",
                    labels = c("Mild Carious Disease", "Severe Carious Disease", 
                               "Periodontitis", "Edentulism")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_axis_labels) +  # Use // instead of //1, //2
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Display and save
ggsave("total_yld_female_break1.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

library(readxl)
gbd_idz <- read_excel("gbd_idz.xlsx")
View(gbd_idz)
df <- read_excel("gbd_idz.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1")


c_p_gbd <- ggplot(df, aes(x = `age group`)) +
  geom_line(aes(
    y = gbd_c_p,
    color = "Prevalence of Carious Disease of Permanent Teeth in GBD",
    group = sex
  )) +
  geom_line(aes(
    y = idz_c_p,
    color = "Prevalence of Carious Disease of Permanent Teeth in DMS V (number of teeth)",
    group = sex
  )) +
  facet_grid(. ~ factor(sex, levels = c("Male", "Female"))) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x / 1e6, "M")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of Prevalence of Carious Disease of Permanent Teeth, by Age and Gender",
    y = "Prevalence (in Millions)",
    x = "Age Group",
    color = "Source"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Prevalence of Carious Disease of Permanent Teeth in GBD" = "red",
    "Prevalence of Carious Disease of Permanent Teeth in DMS V (number of teeth)" = "deepskyblue"
  )) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) paste0(x, " years")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "vertical",
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
  )


ggsave("c_p_gbd.png", plot = c_p_gbd, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
c_yld_gbd <- ggplot(df, aes(x = `age group`)) +

  )) +

    y = idz_cm_yld,
    color = "YLDs per 100,000 for Mild Carious Disease in DMS V (number of teeth)",

  geom_line(aes(
    y = idz_cs_yld,

    group = sex

    labels = function(x) paste0(formatC(x, format = "f", big.mark = ",", digits = 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of YLDs for Carious Disease of Permanent Teeth, by Age and Gender",
    y = "YLDs per 100,000",
    x = "Age Group",
    color = "Source",
    linetype = "Severity"

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "YLDs per 100,000 for Carious Disease of Permanent Teeth in GBD (number of cases)" = "red",
```

```{r}
 p_p_gbd <- ggplot(df, aes(x = `age group`)) +
  geom_line(aes(
    y = gbd_p_p,
    color = "Prevalence of Periodontitis in GBD",
    group = sex
  )) +
  geom_line(aes(
    y = idz_p_p,
    color = "Prevalence of Periodontitis in DMS V",
    group = sex
  )) +
  facet_grid(. ~ factor(sex, levels = c("Male", "Female"))) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x / 1e6, "M")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of Prevalence of Periodontitis, by Age and Gender",
    y = "Prevalence (in Millions)",
    x = "Age Group",
    color = "Source"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Prevalence of Periodontitis in GBD" = "red",
    "Prevalence of Periodontitis in DMS V" = "deepskyblue"
  )) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) paste0(x, " years")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

ggsave("p_p_gbd.png", plot = p_p_gbd, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```
